spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Passage

---

**¶5:** The first good that Divine Wisdom does for those who receive it is its illumination, which it pours into their understanding. It opens the intellectual sight of all. They perceive the way of life as they walk in it. It removes the blindness of spiritual ignorance, which had closed their understanding with its falsity.

**¶6:** The second: When Divine Truth enters the mind, with its coming it brings heavenly calm and peace to the whole of the interior life. With its coming it removes from them all the dread and anguish with which their will is filled during the entire state of spiritual darkness; for it dispels the falsities present by its wisdom, and sweeps them out. And in this way it extinguishes spiritual anxiety by its peace.

**¶7:** The third is its awakening power; because when Divine Truth enters the mind, all who were in spiritual torpor arise and become conscious. And the merely external vigilances of the natural mind cease to be needed. The protective truths that guard the outer entrances of the ordered life lay down their watch, because the light of wisdom has illumined them inwardly.

**¶8:** The fourth: It nourishes and gives vitality, essential goodness, and the delight of perception, to all perceptions of truth and their good works, and to all forms of natural knowledge, and to every germinating insight and beginning of spiritual growth, and to the first openings of new understanding, which are throughout the whole natural mind.

**¶9:** The fifth: When Divine Wisdom shines throughout the whole mind, the lowest sensual falsities and the cruel lusts that are filled with evil flee and conceal themselves in the interior recesses of the proprium.

**¶10:** The sixth: When it shines its wisdom, every spiritual wound in any person is eased from its suffering. Its illumination dissolves the cunning arts of every practitioner of falsity from evil.

**¶11:** The seventh: Divine Wisdom reveals and manifests to the mind the sign of the glory of the heavenly states of good and truth, from which it has proceeded; it here in the natural mind being their representative. It brings illumination to the whole of the created soul.

---

**¶13:** The state of spiritual darkness — for it contains all evils within it. Whenever this darkness descends, it inflicts seven complete evils upon the inner life.

**¶14:** The first evil that spiritual darkness does in the mind is the falsity with which it fills the entire inner life; because when Divine Truth withdraws from the mind and gathers to itself its rays of illumination, at that instant the shadow of spiritual ignorance spreads over the whole interior. The understanding of the people fills with obscurity. They neither perceive nor apprehend anything with their intellectual sight, because of the falsity of ignorance which fills the whole mind.

**¶15:** The second evil that spiritual darkness does is its dread; because when its shadow looms forth, its terror and its anguish take possession of the whole will. The entire inner life fills with this darkness.

**¶16:** The third: When spiritual darkness descends, all affections take up rebellion. They turn in the will toward evil and destruction.

**¶17:** The fourth: The weight of spiritual insensibility falls upon them, and they lose all awareness; they become torpid and deadened, and they are like the spiritually dead in this state of darkness.

**¶18:** The fifth is its deformity; again, when this darkness descends, the true form of persons is hidden in the falsity and the spiritual ugliness of this ignorance. The beauty of good and the form of truth in understanding and will are not displayed to one another, because of the falsity and its deformity, which it spreads over all their spiritual forms.

**¶19:** The cruel lusts come forth, and all the lowest sensual falsities that are filled with evil, from their interior hiding places. And they prowl through the state of darkness. Also, the spirits of hell and evil presences find power to do evil in the darkness. Again, the assaults and violences and injuries and impurities torment persons in this darkness; because in it the whole of evil finds its strength.

**¶20:** The seventh: Spiritual darkness displays the sign of primordial Falsity, its origin. It has risen out of its very essence; because this darkness of the mind that emerged from the original realm of Falsity-from-Evil has been made manifest in the created life. Behold this spiritual darkness, the shadow of that primordial Falsity, the one that is interwoven and bound into all things of the interior and the exterior mind.

---

**¶22:** There are five essential qualities present in Divine Wisdom, which it makes [GAP-1] manifest as it enters the mind.

**¶23:** The first is its illumination; for it enlightens by its wisdom the whole mind, and all the affections and thoughts that exist in it.

**¶24:** The second is its beauty of form; because when it shines, it pours the beauty and delight of spiritual order upon all affections and upon everything.

**¶25:** The third is its peace; for, again, when Divine Wisdom shines upon the mind, all faculties of the person receive mutual love through it, and give peace to one another.

**¶26:** The fourth is the liberation of the living spiritual essence, which it releases from all the bonds and fetters of interior and exterior falsity.

**¶27:** The fifth: It gives strength to the foundational goods and truths; and also it gives the inner delight and essential goodness to the whole suffering fabric of spiritual life in bondage.

**¶28:** Its wisdom illumines more than all lesser truths that occur in the mind. Also, its spiritual beauty exceeds all the forms that people possess of themselves. Again, its peace surpasses all the powers and protective states that exist in the mind. Its liberating action, by which it frees the living spiritual essence, is wholly prior to all other liberations! The strength that it gives to its members is a great strength, being mightier than all other strengths!

---

**¶29:** Once again, there are another three essential qualities made manifest by Divine Wisdom, with respect to the mystery of the Divine Itself in its infinite fullness.

**¶30:** The first is the perpetual fullness of the containing form of its good; because this containing form is filled in every state, and never diminishes at all, in the way that the containing form of truth-from-good diminishes. This unceasing fullness, by which it is filled, reveals the mystery of the Divine Love, the infinite Itself; from whom all powers and all heavenly beings have proceeded. He never diminishes, nor does any lack ever exist in Him!

**¶31:** The second: The wisdom of Divine Truth surpasses the light of all particular knowledges of truth, and all illuminations that exist in the created order; corresponding to the mystery of the light of the Divine Love; for His wisdom surpasses and is greater than the illumination of all His heavenly states.

**¶32:** The third: This Divine Wisdom is exalted above all else. It surpasses the elevation of all the highest states of love and charity that exist throughout the whole natural mind, corresponding to the mystery of the Divine Love of the infinite Itself; for He is exalted above all the household of His heavenly realm. Also, because the Divine Itself is exalted above all the heights and the elevated states of love in His heaven. He is perpetually full in His own image [GAP-2: REVIEW all] through every state and every moment from eternity to eternity!

---

**¶33:** The mystery of spiritual darkness and that of spiritual illumination, which daily alternate in the mind. Now, the mystery of Divine Truth and the mystery of Falsity-from-Evil are displayed daily in the soul's experience.

**¶34:** The mystery of the first great Divine Wisdom is this secondary illumination, the one that comes daily into the mind. It displays all the marks of its blessings, revealing and signifying on its own account that it is good, out of the essence of the good. It came from the Divine Love and appeared in the created life.

**¶35:** In contrast, this spiritual darkness that is made of dread exists after the pattern of primordial Falsity. Behold too the mystery of its essence! It manifests it in the mind through all these evils. It displays this mystery daily in the inner life, but the doctrinal systems in their error do not recognize it. They do not distinguish the mystery of Divine Truth from that of Falsity-from-Evil.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first good thing that it does for them is its light, which it shines upon them. It opens the eyes of all mankind. They see underfoot as they walk by it. It takes away the blindness of the night, which made them blind with its darkness.

The second: When (the sun) is come to the world, with its coming it shall bring calm and peace to the entire world. With its coming it shall also take away from them all the fear and trembling, which their heart is filled with the whole night; for it shall take away the darkness present by its light, and sweep it out. Also, this is how it extinguishes fear by its calm.

The third is its vigil; because when (the sun) comes to the world all sleeping mankind shall arise and awake. And the watchmen too shall cease from watching. The guards who sit at the gates of camps, they break vigil at the watchposts, because of its light that has shone upon them in the world.
The fourth: It shall nourish, and give strength, taste and scent, to the trees and fruits and vegetables, and all the herbs, and the flowers and grasses, which are upon the entire earth.
The fifth: When (the sun) shines in all the world, the evil reptile and the sharp-toothed beasts that are filled of wickedness, they shall flee to hiding in their dens.
The sixth: When it shines its light, the wound of any person is eased from pain. Its light shall melt away the evil arts of every doer of wickedness.

The seventh: (The sun) shall display and manifest to the world the sign of the splendour of the aeons of light, from which it has come out; it here in this world being their sign. It brings light to the whole of creation.
the night, for it has all wickednesses therein. Every occasion, would the night fall, it shall do seven evils in the world.

The first wickedness that the night shall do in the world is the darkness, with which it shall fill the entire world; because when the sun sinks from the world and draws to it its rays, at that instant the shadow of the night shall spread out over the whole world. The eyes of the people fill with blackness. They neither see nor wonder with their eyes, because of the darkness of the night which shall fill the whole world.
The second evil thing that the night shall do is its fear; because when its shadow looms forth, its fear and its trembling shall possess all of mankind. The entire world shall fill of the night.
The third: When the night falls, all creatures take up revolt. They rebel in their heart, to do wickedness and perdition.
The fourth: The heaviness of sleep shall lay upon them, and they fall asleep; they slumber and doze, and they are like these corpses in the night.

The fifth is its ugliness; again, when the night would fall, the form of the people shall be hidden in the darkness and the ugliness of the night. The beauty and the form of men and women shall not be displayed before one another, because of its darkness and its ugliness, which it shall spread out over all their forms.

The evil beasts shall come out, and all the reptiles that are filled with wickedness, from their dens. And they stalk in the night. Also, the demons and fiends find power to do wickedness in the night. Again, the blows and buffets and wounds and discharges shall torment people in the night; because in it the whole of evil shall find strength.

The seventh: The night shall display the sign of the darkness, its father. It has arisen out of its essence; because this night that came out of this first Darkness has been displayed in the world. Note this night, the shadow of this first Darkness, the one that is entwined and bound in all things above and below.
There are five archetypes occur in the sun, it making them [manifest] as it finds the world.
The first is its light; for it illumines by its light the world, and all the creatures who exist in it.
The second is its beauty; because when it shines, it shall flood beauty and loveliness upon all creatures and everything.
The third is its peace; for, again, when the sun would shine on the world, all people shall receive affection through it, and give peace to one another.
The fourth is the life of the living soul, which it shall release from all the bonds and fetters of heaven and earth.
The fifth: It gives a strength to the elements; and also it gives a scent and a taste to the entire Cross of the Light.

its light illumines more than all lights that occur in the world. Also, its beauty is more beautiful than all the beauties of mankind. Again, its peace is more surpassing than all the powers and guards who exist in the world. Its releasing action, by which it releases the living soul, is a full day ahead of all releasing actions! The strength that it gives to its limbs is a great strength, being mightier than all strengths!
Once again, there are another three archetypes made apparent by the sun, in respect of the mystery of the first greatness.

The first is the filling up of the disk of its ship; because its ship has filled up every season, and shall not wane at all, the way that the ship of the moon wanes. This continuous filling, by which it is filled, displays the mystery of the Father, the great greatness; from whom all the powers and the gods have come forth. He shall never wane, nor shall lack ever exist in him!

The second: (The sun's) light surpasses the light of all the stars, and all the lights that occur in the universe; corresponding to the mystery of the light of the Father; for his light surpasses and is greater than the light of his aeons.

The third: This sun is very high above all else. It surpasses the height of all the mountains and hills that exist upon the entire earth, corresponding to the mystery of the Father of Greatness; for he is high above all the household of his light-earth. Also, because the Father himself is high above all the heights and the mountains of his light-earth. He is 'filled up' in his image [all] the time and every hour from eternity to eternity!
The mystery of the night and that of the day, which daily come forth in the world. Now, the mystery of the light and the mystery of the darkness are displayed daily in the created order.

The mystery of the first great light is the sun, which is this second light-giver, the one that comes daily to the world. It displays all the marks of its graces, displaying and signifying on its own behalf that it is good, out of the essence of the good. It came from the good Father and appeared in this world.

In contrast, this night that is made of fear exists after the mystery of the darkness. Behold too the mystery of its essence! It displays it in the world in all these wickednesses. It displays this mystery daily in the world, but the sects know it not in their error. They do not distinguish the mystery of the light from that of the darkness.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading explicitly states "which it makes manifest as it enters the mind," and "manifest" is the standard Kephalaia vocabulary for the sun displaying or revealing its qualities to the world, consistent with the repeated use of "display and manifest" throughout the chapter (e.g., ¶11).

The editor's "all" is confirmed: "in his image all the time and every hour from eternity to eternity" correctly expresses the perpetual fullness of the Divine that the spiritual reading describes, and fits the grammatical construction naturally.
